protocol: Lossless fixtures compare byte-exact against the pinned Release oracle payload. Lossy ceilings were fixed before any Dart decoder run: observed inter-build OpenJPEG deltas (Release 8314119b vs Debug 8314119b, all zero on this corpus) plus a float-precision allowance of 3 sample levels / RMSE 0.5 for a float64 decoder matching the float32 oracle pipeline, capped by the globals. Loosening them afterwards invalidates acceptance; tightening is always allowed.
